title: Lush Cheesy Australian Beef Burger
description: A briny, cheesy Australian dish featuring beef, Appleton rum, and bhuna spices, served in an agave leaf vessel, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat a grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, Appleton rum, and bhuna spice mix.
Form the beef mixture into 4 large patties.
Grill the patties for 5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Meanwhile, toast the agave leaves over the grill until they are slightly charred.
Assemble the burgers by placing a cooked patty onto each agave leaf, followed by a slice of cheese, some lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles.
Return the burgers to the grill and cook until the cheese is melted and the agave leaves are slightly crispy.
Serve the burgers immediately and enjoy.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
